Subsequent steps relied on this flawed enumeration, so correcting this earliest constraint error would have prevented the wrong final answer.

Had the distribution space been correctly enumerated (allowing any pair to differ by 6), the optimal guarantee and final answer would change. Subsequent verification merely inherited this error.
